intro: We are a family-owned garage door company serving all of Lombard, Illinois. Our technicians handle every common garage door problem. We keep our trucks stocked with the necessary parts to complete most repairs in a single visit, often on the same day you call. Before we begin any work, we provide an upfront, flat-rate quote. After the job is done, we perform a balance and safety-reverse test to ensure everything operates correctly. We are available 24 hours a day, from Monday through Saturday, for emergency service anywhere in Lombard. Book your appointment online to receive a 10% discount on the service.
localContext: Lombard's ground conditions present specific garage door challenges. The area's clay soil causes many older, detached garages to settle over time. This is common in the bungalows around the Lilacia Park area. As the foundation shifts, the garage door opening becomes out-of-square, which pinches the vertical tracks. This adds stress to rollers and can cause the door to bind, especially during humid summers. The consistent frame movement also means a door's spring balance will drift more quickly than usual, requiring regular adjustment. In the neighborhoods toward Yorktown, the 1960s and 70s ranch homes often have their original attached garages. While more stable, these doors are frequently on their second or third opener, leading to compatibility issues with modern safety sensors and worn-out mechanical parts. Our technicians understand how to diagnose and correct these specific Lombard-area problems.
